titulo: With me, with you, for you
intro: The pronouns that follow a preposition, and a few more prepositions.
p.conmigo.consejo: It is «con» + «mí» in a single word: «¿vienes conmigo?». You do not say «con mí» or «con yo».
p.contigo.consejo: It is «con» + «ti» in a single word: «voy contigo». You do not say «con ti» or «con tú».
p.mí.consejo: After a preposition, «yo» becomes «mí»: «para mí». It has an accent; «mi» without one is «my».
p.ti.consejo: After a preposition, «tú» becomes «ti»: «para ti», «sin ti». It never has an accent.
p.sí.consejo: With an accent it is «yes» and also the reflexive pronoun: «habla de sí misma». Without one, «si» is «if».
p.entre tú y yo.consejo: After «entre» «tú» and «yo» stay: «entre tú y yo». You do not say «entre ti y mí».
p.según.consejo: It introduces an opinion or a source: «según Ana». With a pronoun use tú and yo: «según tú». It has an accent.
p.sin.consejo: It is the opposite of «con»: «sin ti», «sin prisa». After «sin» you use «ti», not «tú».
p.sobre.consejo: It can be «on top of» or «about»: «sobre la mesa», «un libro sobre música».
p.hacia.consejo: It shows the direction, not the arrival: «camino hacia el mercado». In Spain the «c» sounds «th».
p.las bolsas.consejo: It is feminine plural. In Spain «la bolsa» is what you use to carry your shopping.
p.el mercado.consejo: It is the place where fruit, vegetables and bread are sold. It is masculine: «el mercado».
b1.texto:
After almost all prepositions you use the tonic pronouns: **mí, ti, él, ella, usted, nosotros, vosotros, ellos, ellas, ustedes**.

- para **mí**, sin **ti**, de **él**, a **nosotros**

**Con** joins with **mí** and **ti**: **conmigo**, **contigo**. The others stay separate: con él, con ella, con nosotros.

**Entre**, **según** and **excepto** keep **tú** and **yo**: **entre tú y yo**, **según tú**.

When the pronoun repeats the subject of the sentence, you use **sí**: Ana habla de **sí** misma. With «con»: **consigo**.

More prepositions: **sin** (without), **sobre** (on, about), **hacia** (towards), **entre** (between).
b2.titulo: On the way to the market
b2.f0.texto: Are you coming with me to the market?
b2.f1.texto: Yes, I am going with you.
b2.f2.texto: Without you I cannot carry the bags.
b2.f5.texto: Ana talks about you a lot.
b2.f6.texto: Between you and me, she is my best friend.
b2.f7.texto: Then we walk towards the market with the bags.
b4.texto:
Compare the subject pronoun with the one after a preposition:

- yo → **mí**: para mí; con → **conmigo**
- tú → **ti**: para ti; con → **contigo**
- él, ella, usted → **él, ella, usted**: con él, de ella
- nosotros, vosotros, ellos… → **the same**: a nosotros, sin vosotros
- the subject repeats → **sí**: de sí misma; con → **consigo**

Exceptions: **entre**, **según** and **excepto** use **tú** and **yo**: entre tú y yo, según tú, excepto yo.
b4.e0.texto: I am going with you to the market.
b4.e2.texto: According to you, the market opens today.
b5.f0.texto: My little sister comes with me to the market every Saturday.
b5.f1.texto: We walk slowly towards the square, in no hurry.
b5.f2.texto: Between the white houses rises a smell of bread and orange.
b5.f3.texto: Over our heads fly the birds of the morning.
b5.f4.texto: According to my sister, this is the prettiest market of the year.
b5.f5.texto: Next to the fountain, a seller smiles without saying anything.
b5.f6.texto: He keeps a red apple for me.
b5.f7.texto: My sister picks the sweetest oranges for herself.
b5.f8.texto: Without her, I never buy the freshest vegetables.
b5.f9.texto: We go back home with full bags and a calm heart.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Te» goes with a verb, not after a preposition.
b7.o2.refuerzo: That is it! After «para» you use «ti».
b8.frase: Sin ti no puedo llevar las bolsas
b8.traduccion: Without you I cannot carry the bags
b11.o0.refuerzo: Correct! «Entre» is an exception: it keeps «tú» and «yo».
b11.o1.refuerzo: With «entre» the subject forms are kept.
b11.o2.refuerzo: «Te» and «me» go with a verb, not with a preposition.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Yes! The third-person reflexive takes an accent: sí.
p.llevar.consejo: The ll sounds like «y». The stress is on the last syllable.
p.cabezas.consejo: Plural of «cabeza». The z sounds like «th».
p.vuelan.consejo: From «volar», to fly. The ue sounds like «we».
p.dulces.consejo: The c before e sounds like «th» in Spain.
p.volvemos.consejo: From «volver», to return. The -emos ending means «we».
